non_claims: The inactive template does not restrict ordinary development or select a release candidate.
The finite selected PR/head rows are recorded only after they have landed; active freezes ordinary qualification rather than acting as a serial merge queue.
Activation is a separately reviewed packet-only control commit whose first parent is the exact product cut SHA/tree consumed by #3807, #2768 and #1609.
A packet-only control PR may deactivate or move to candidate_pinned; product changes require reopening and later re-freezing a successor cut.
Qualification, final merge judgment, candidate-ref creation and publication remain separate authorities.
